Name: Large Quail Mayonnaise
Author: ZoeyHoshi
Description:
We need more mayonnaise, Quail Mayonnaise from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25028]Mizu's Quail[/url]﻿ to be precise. Following through with other mods that add large mayonnaise, here is Large Quail Mayonnaise.

This mod, like my others, is completely [i]configurable[/i]
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/reJiWiN.png[/img][/center]

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/u9ar2JH.png[/img]﻿[/center]
1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25028]Mizu's Quail[/url]﻿
3. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for easy configurations
4. Download the main .zip file from this mod and install it
5. When starting the game for the first time since installing, use Generic Mod Config Menu to configure the mod to your liking

You're all done and ready to play.

[center]﻿﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/WJY3wnv.png[/img]﻿[/center]﻿
